notes: based_on is a subproperty of derivative_of (transitive); 'the distribution Ubuntu is based on' presupposes one, so Func(based_on) is firm (README: one-value presupposition). 'No distribution is derived from both Arch Linux and Debian' is a firm exclusivity the original 'no' answers (q-near and q-far) need; the record does not state it, so it is encoding glue. Numbered stable releases is a class (Debian yes, Arch Linux no: rolling). q2 is fol (temporal): first release year in the 1990s.
